environment: **Organization**: None. Personal GitHub account radiosilence; work uses a separate config dir (.claude-work) and is out of scope here
**Source control**: repos under github.com/radiosilence and their remotes; checkouts under ~/workspace/radiosilence, worktrees under ~/workspace/<org>/worktrees
**Host**: personal macOS laptop with open internet; no containment
**Cloud provider(s)**: Hetzner (VPS), Cloudflare (DNS); a home k3s cluster reached over Tailscale with no inbound ports
**Secrets management**: 1Password. Claude sessions use a read-only service account on the Claude vault; Pulumi stack config for infra; GitHub repository secrets for CI
**Sensitive data**: .env and *.key files, Pulumi stack config, anything read via op — never echo, commit or send off the machine
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None; public paste and gist services are outside the trust boundary
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota and node-pool resources in any Pulumi stack
**Tooling**: mise, gh, op, pulumi, kubectl, herdr
**Primary use of Claude Code**: personal software development and self-hosted infrastructure
